notes.title: Update: Tweaked how M2M Coverage Works
notes.content:
[h1][b]Man-to-Man Coverage[/b][/h1]

The M2M Coverage is working with a couple of caveats
1. we disabled the "assigned" double coverage ability

      - double coverages still happen, they are done by having "extra" defensive players who have an "open" M2M assignment and cannot find a free receiver to cover. 

2. we changed some of the priority progressions that defensive players make in order to determine who they are supposed to match up against

       - watch this our Explainer Video on how to assign M2M coverages and who is going to man up with their offensive counterpart
[previewyoutube=MSa22JwnzoQ;full][/previewyoutube]

       - here is an [url=https://greatsofthegridiron.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/M2M-Explainervideo.pdf]accompanying explanation[/url] that is provided in the video

As always, hit us up with any questions you might have. We are available here on Steam as well as on [url=https://discord.gg/adQZKXqsrZ]Discord[/url]. 

- The Management Team

[b]Official Season #1 kicks off in 1 week (4/1/23)!! [/b]

notes.title: League Draft Results and Strongside/Weakside Defensive Formations
notes.content:
[h1][b]The First Official Greats of the Gridiron Draft![/b][/h1] 

It was a huge success! Thanks to all those who have joined this historic, first league and season. We are looking forward to seeing who takes home the Gridiron Bowl!!

Here was the video on the Top 10 Players [previewyoutube=sGCLUi1cV1k;full][/previewyoutube]

The main pick window:

[img]https://i0.wp.com/greatsofthegridiron.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/Banner-01.png?resize=1080%2C608&ssl=1[/img]

[h2]The draft is over and the players are signed![/h2]

Now that the league is has its Coaches and Players, playbook design is underway. With that, we have just finished the final touches of getting defenses to [b]read[/b] [i]and[/i] [b]adjust[/b] to the offense's strong and weak side formations. Here's a breakdown of how it works. 

In the [b]first[/b] [b]image[/b], there is an "orange shaded" box dividing the defensive field in half. That is the [i]defense's strongside[/i]. Whomever is lined up in this box will SHIFT to the Offense's  Strongside (see Image 2) when they take the practice field or in a game. 

The strongside in the [b]first image[/b] is where the TE is lined up. In this case, the TE is on the LEFT side of the Offensive formation. 

[img]https://i0.wp.com/greatsofthegridiron.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/Strong-Side-01.png?w=823&ssl=1[/img] IMAGE 1


See how the defensive players in the orange box set in the Coordinator's Office adjusted to where the offense's strongside is? ([b]image 2[/b]) below.

[img]https://i0.wp.com/greatsofthegridiron.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/Strong-Side-02.png?w=820&ssl=1[/img] IMAGE 2

When doing this, coaches have the freedom to tell the defensive players to overload the strongside OR weakside with the players they so want. If you wanted to overload the weakside, all the coach needs to do it line up everyone on the [b]Weak Side[/b] - the non-shaded part.... and the defense will adjust accordingly. See [b]Image 3[/b]

[img]https://i0.wp.com/greatsofthegridiron.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/Strong-Side-03.png?w=821&ssl=1[/img] IMAGE 3

And now on the Practice Field, all those players have shifted to the [b]Weakside[/b] (see image 4)

[img]https://i0.wp.com/greatsofthegridiron.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/Strong-Side-04.png?w=818&ssl=1[/img] IMAGE 4

Now defenses can blitz from the weakside or strongside with the personnel that best fits [b]any[/b] situation.

[h2][b]IMPORTANT DATABASE UPDATE[/b][/h2]
This update include a needed change to the encrypted play data. In order to do this, the UI is going to be locked on a black screen for several minutes, more or less depending on your PC specs. 

Please don't close the game during this process, or it will corrupt your database. If you need any assistance or have any questions, please post on the message boards or directly on Discord.

tags.feature: Now that the league is has its Coaches and Players, playbook design is underway. With that, we have just finished the final touches of getting defenses to read and adjust to the offense's strong and weak side formations.

notes.title: Dedicated Server, 32 Teams and Official League Start
notes.content:
[h1]*** Please Read if you Purchased (or otherwise acquired) the Game Prior to January, 26 2023 ***[/h1]


[h2]Dedicated Server[/h2]

We didn't get a lot of feedback from people regarding the upcoming new release and use of the DEDICATED SERVER - so we are making one last post regarding this. There will be forthcoming tutorials and a manual on how to run a league via dedicated server.

We expect that [b]upon the release of this next version[/b] that current users (owners of the game) will have invalid databases. This unfortunately means that your data (playbooks and team files) will not be usable when the new release happens...

AGAIN, WORRY NOT!

For a limited time, if you are a current owner of GotG prior to this release, we will work with you to update your database so it is valid with the new release!

Please reach out to us via Steam or [url=https://discord.gg/adQZKXqsrZ]Discord[/url].

---------

[h2]32 Teams[/h2]

Additionally, with the new release the game will support 32 teams! This includes a season scheduler and playoff system! 

---------

[h2]Official League[/h2]

The sign-up period for the Official League ends today!  We have a good group of coaches ready to compete for the coveted Gridiron Bowl trophy and bragging rights as the first ever GotG Champion! which will earn them an automatic spot in our Hall of Fame! 

[b]It's not too late to sign up though if you haven't. If you want to sign up, head over and join Discord or shoot us a message here. [/b]

[list]
[*] If you want to sign up AFTER 1/27/2023 but [b]before[/b] the first game kicks off, you can. Just message us on Steam or [url=https://discord.gg/adQZKXqsrZ]Discord[/url] and we (as well as the other league members) will decide who to accommodate you. 
[/list]

We could not do this without your continued support. We cannot thank you enough. Honestly. And we hope that with this new release, leagues will begin to form and more and more people will play this amazing game!

Cheers!

notes.title: Multiplayer and 32 Team UPDATE!
notes.content:
UPDATE! 

Great news everyone!  After months of hard work, we are in the final stages of implementing (and testing) the multiplayer functionality. This will allow for online drafting and league play!! 

Details: 
1. There will be a full online draft 
2. Contracts are in place, but they will not yet be adhered to
3. A dedicated server will be needed (we will set up tutorials on setting up and we will always be available here and in Discord for help)

We also had a lot of feedback about getting 32 teams in the game - and we will have that, too! 

Details:
1. A fully automated scheduler for regular season and playoffs

Our expected release date of the multiplayer and 32 teams is January 1st.  It may be sooner based on a few caveats such as how well testing goes as well as if anyone who has the game would like to contribute to making some of the additional 16 default teams!!  This is a chance to immortalize your coaching prowess for the masses... 

There will be more information about the default team building in [url=https://discord.gg/adQZKXqsrZ]DISCORD[/url], so please be sure to join us there! 

Thanks again for all your support and patience as we continue to update the game.

notes.title: UPDATE: SCOUTING
notes.content:
[b]Update: 08/19/2022 [/b]

We are toiling away in our War Room as we design and code more features of Greats of the Gridiron. Currently, we are closing in on one of the most enjoyable aspects to the season - scouting the next crop of college kids waiting for their shot at Greatness! 

For the most part, during the course of the season coaches can scout specific attribute point totals for one price or a range that is represented by a grade at a sizeable discount. Another option is to simply scout their overall grade. These 3 scouting options will make increase strategic thinking in order to try and get the most comprehensive draft board possible.

Commissioners of each league will have the ability to: 

[olist]
[*] Choose to use scouting mode for their league
[*] Choose the weekly scouting points allotted
[*] Choose whether or not the allotted points are on a "use or lose" basis
[/olist] 
Again, our main goal is to give as much customization to each commissioner as possible so that each league can be tailored for the most fun for each individual league. 

Additional advanced settings that are coming are Injury Mode and Contract Mode

Here's a sneak peek at the Main Screen for Scouting... 

[img]https://i0.wp.com/greatsofthegridiron.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Scouting-Player-Card-hover-02.png?w=1027&ssl=1[/img]

notes.title: Update Re-post: 0.1.321
notes.content:
The previous update is being re-posted here due to some issues with the prior post visibility. This update is rather major, and although there are no issue reports since 9, June, nevertheless please read the below:

Update 0.1.321:
Additions/Improvements
* Add fans to stadium for better immersion at game time. Use the Options Menu to enable or disable the fans as well as the count that show up to game day.
* Custom emblems can now be imported and used for your teams. Please watch the tutorial video https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JaOv4xod27E on how to set up and import your custom logo into the game. NOTE: league commissioners will have to distribute any league team's custom emblem to the league coaches. Logos MUST be 512x512 in size and be in .png format, or it won't work!

IMPORTANT:
If you are updating from prior to 0.1.321, please follow the below instructions to configure your data source locations for your current leagues. If you are not concerned with any previous data, you can simply start the game and use the automatically created league.

[olist]
[*] After updating start the game, accept the Privacy Statement and wait for the game to automatically create a default league as it will on first run.
[*] PLEASE READ THIS STEP CAREFULLY: 

Once completed, go to the Options menu. Click the folder icon next to the Data Directory option. Use this to select your preferred directory to save your data files. NOTE: this location should be a substantially large location as the data will get to be quite sizable over time. 

ADDITIONALLY: you are under no obligation to change this from the default setting, however you may want to if you have a larger space to save to.

FURTHER: I am not deleting any of your files during this process, so if you are careful and something goes wrong, you will not have lost your data unless you deleted or overwrote it yourself. So - please be careful and feel free to ask for help on Discord or the Message Boards before moving any files.

[*] Close the game - this is important as once you copy your leagues, the game will need to update your current databases on startup.
[*] Changing this data location will copy the default (any any other) league to this new location under a new "Leagues" directory.
[*] Navigate to your Steam installation and navigate to the "<SteamInstall>/steamapps/common/Greats Of The Gridiron/GreatsOfTheGridiron/Saved/data" directory. In here, you will see your current league directories.
[*] Copy all these league folders to your selected <dataSource>/Leagues directory. If you already have a Default league
[*] Start the game, go to a module (Play, Coordinator's Office, or League Management) and File->Open League. You should see all your previous leagues to be available to play.
[/olist]

As usual, please ask on Discord or on the message boards if you need any assistance.

Fixes:
* Entry Menu buttons incorrectly enabled while validating the installation
* Tweaks to grass materials
* Crash when using File Dialogs
* Improve general performance significantly.
* Clean up some logging warnings

notes.title: Inaugural League and Game Update
notes.content:
First - we are still looking for a few more coaches to join our inaugural league. We currently have 11 coaches ready to go but we need 5 more brave people to pit their skills against the rest of the league. 

While we could go with just 11, we feel it best to have a league full of humans so that no one is coaching against NPCs and this way trading will be more fun and active as will the initial draft. So, if you know anyone who wants to be part of history - have them reach out to us. 

Game development: 

1. We always knew in the back of our minds that a custom logo importer was needed - well look no further as it will be in the next release. Instructions on how this will work are coming soon

2. In the next build there will be a performance boost! Yay, say all those who are on the lower end of the specs. 

3. We have added some "eye-candy" and in the next build you can have fans in your stadium! This will be a feature that can be turned on or off to help with any kind of performance on the PC. But it looks great and adds that extra detail. it's only visible when in the 3D mode of the camera during the games.

One of the things we are looking to add is a way to test the PCA without having to play games as well as a randomizer when you're practicing an offensive or defensive play out. Stay tuned as we work on those.

Again we want to thank everyone for their feedback and support - it's because you of you that we're able to make this game better and better.

notes.title: Launch Postponement/Kickstarter
notes.content:
Hey Everyone! 

First, thank you all for your support over the last year and half. We are extremely grateful for all the feedback you've provided us, as well as the encouragement that what we've been toiling over for so long now is worth it - even more, that pushing the release date back to put out a FULL and COMPLETE game that has all the bells and whistles we initially wanted, in addition to a lot of the ideas generated by the community - is the best way to go. 

With that said, [b]we are pushing the release date for Greats of the Gridiron to early spring 2022.[/b]

[b]Perhaps the biggest reason for the pushback is that we want to expand to 31 default teams, improve the CPU's AI especially in terms of them being able to draft against you, as well as their play calling ability so that it's more adaptive. [/b]

Here are the other feature coming: 

[b]SINGLE PLAYER[/b]

* Season Mode (just play a season with a playoff) 
* Franchise Mode (play multiple season with drafts and retirements and salary cap)
* 31 default teams rather than 15
* Simulate the games between computer teams
* Full assortment of stats and the ability to download
* Computer simulated draft 

[b]MULTIPLAYER (ONLINE)[/b]

* Not a lot of new features are going on here but we are working on improving the draft user interface as well as graphics (including character portraits)

[b]Play Characteristics[/b]

* Player injury % (some players are more prone to injury and we want to factor that in)
* Diamond in the Rough feature (some draftees are like TB12 and can be a diamond!  Whereas some like Jamarcus Russell are a fool's gold - we want to explore this option in both multi and single player modes
* Character portraits - we want to get better and more variety

The other main reason is that a lot of community members had expressed interest in "getting in on the action" and helping us create default teams and playbooks for the game's initial release - and we thought this was a great idea because it would add so much more variety/parody to the game for single player mode. 

So, we've decided to launch a Kickstarter campaign that gives everyone the opportunity to enjoy some of the new perks we're making available. We didn't want to exclude anyone without first giving them the opportunity.  

Here's quick look at some of the opportunities backers will get: 

[list]
[*] Get the game at a discounted price
[/list]
[list]
[*] Get the game before it's release on Steam
[/list]
[list]
[*] Have access to the Coordinator's Office where you can create a team and playbook well in advance of the game's release so that you're ahead of the pack
[/list]
[list]
[*] Name one of the Default Teams, pick their logo, have your name as the head coach
[/list]
[list]
[*] Have your name as one of the QBs, HBs or WRs (any position)
[/list]

Again, to recap - we are pushing the release date back to early spring 2022 so that we can work on bringing the game to MAC users, improve and expand on single player mode, give community members the opportunity to leave their mark on the default teams which will ship to every new user. We are also working on a redesign of the end zone, more sound effects and a Hall of Fame bust area where your players can retire and be seen by the world (complete with clickable interface that shows their stats and bio (which you get to write up). 

We hope you continue to support us despite what might be an initial disappointment at the delay. We promise you that this is only to make the game as greats possible from day one because that's what every gamer deserves. 

We are looking at launching the Kickstarter campaign around October 1st. We will link here for that. 

Until then - please always feel free to reach out to us: greatsofthegridirion@gmail.com

- The Management Team

notes.title: Team/Playbook Transfer Now Happening!
notes.content:
We have successfully transferred a playbook and team from a computer in Wyoming to a computer in Maryland!! So now you can create a team and playbook, send it to a friend (or challenger) and find out who has the better players, plays and coaching ability...

Additionally,  another important feature has been completed and that is the Play Commentary. Now you can review the plays called for analysis. There's also a nice scoring summary as part of the commentary.
